name: Doki Doki Ragnarok
source:
You are a powerful viking! And Odin has granted you a QUEST!

Pillage, conquer, chat and flirt with villages all over the world in this historically accurate viking adventure. Will you find the inanimate location of your heart?

[From [url=https://brutalhack.itch.io/doki-doki-ragnarok-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名强大的维京人！奥丁赐予了你一项任务！

在这场符合史实的维京冒险中，劫掠、征服世界各地的村庄，与它们聊天、调情。你能找到那座令你心动的无生命聚落吗？

[摘自[url=https://brutalhack.itch.io/doki-doki-ragnarok-demo]itch.io[/url]]
